name: financial-research
description: Pull company financials, SEC filings, and analyst consensus for a public company. Use this skill whenever the user says "10-K", "10-Q", "earnings", "revenue of", "financials for", "analyst rating for", "price target for", or provides a stock ticker. Combines SEC EDGAR for official filings with Yahoo Finance / TipRanks for analyst data. Search + scrape only; no interact needed.
